titles: 창원 회사가 독일 132년 명가를 3,243억에 사들이기 6주 전, 유럽이 조용히 뒤집은 규칙
"엔진은 이제 안 팔린다" 독일 132년 명가를 무너뜨린 규칙, 창원이 사들이기 직전에 풀렸습니다
창원이 3,243억에 사들인 독일 132년 명가, 그 회사를 무너뜨린 건 한국이 아니었습니다
thumbnail_texts: "이 규칙 때문에 접었다" + "인수 6주 전 지워진 규칙" + 리액션 "허탈하네"
"엔진은 끝났다더니" + "헬러가 팔린 뒤 바뀐 규정" + 리액션 "타이밍 참"
"우린 못 버틴다고 했다" + "창원이 사들인 뒤 풀린 족쇄" + 리액션 "운도 실력"
meta.anchor_ref: 002 — 국산 공작기계, "한국에 팔 줄은 몰랐다" 독일 132년 명가가 창원 회사에 통째로 넘어간 진짜 이유 (계승 불성립 판정 — 7~9번은 감정 클로즈업으로 대체)

thumbnails.concept_ko: 주문이 마르고 조업단축이 걸린 뉘르팅겐 엔진 가공 라인이 불을 내린 순간. 파트2의 '전기요금 10.94→35.70센트 · 수주액이 매출보다 1억 4,600만 유로 적음 · 224명 감축'이 근거다. 사건의 무대를 먼저 보여줘야 뒤의 규칙 반전이 성립하므로 현장 장면을 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished concrete factory floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A vast German machine shop assembly bay at night: a huge HELLER horizontal machining centre stands dead centre with a grey dust sheet half draped over its spindle, the blue HELLER logo on its cast housing lit by one weak emissive cold-blue strip, and rows of empty steel material pallets recede behind it in exaggerated wide-angle perspective while deep cracks spread across the painted wall. In front of the dead machine stands a German master machinist in a navy work coat, hard rim light separating him from the black background: eyebrows pulled together into a hard V, jaw clenched so the muscle stands out on his cheek, lower lip pressed flat, both hands gripping a bare cast engine cylinder block against his chest, gaze cast downward at the silent spindle. The entire frame is dominated by only two colours — glowing steel-blue emergency light flooding everything, cut by a single dying bar of amber work-light bleeding across the far wall — with cold vapour drifting through the beams and bloom around every light source. No headline text, no caption text, no subtitle overlay, no numbers, no watermark; the only lettering anywhere is the HELLER brand logo described above, printed as a physical mark on the machine itself.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 수주액이 매출 아래로 내려앉아 곳간이 비어가던 국면. 파트2의 '수주 3억 9,100만 유로 < 매출 5억 3,700만 유로 → 순손실 535억'이 근거다. 숫자 변화 자체가 사건이므로 하강 화살표 구도를 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain dark polished floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Thorsten Schmidt (HELLER CEO) stands chest-up on the right side of the frame in a dark suit, brightly lit by a hard studio key light: eyes wide open showing the whites above the iris, eyebrows lifted and pinched together, mouth slightly agape, one palm pressed flat to his forehead pushing his hair back, beads of sweat on his temple, flushed cheeks. Behind and to his left a colossal thick glowing red neon downward arrow slams diagonally through the factory hall toward a row of completely empty blue steel order racks, its red light spilling across the empty shelves and across a half-machined engine cylinder block abandoned on a trolley, while the small blue HELLER logo on the rack frame glows faintly. Only two colours rule the frame — searing emissive red against deep charcoal-blue industrial darkness — with sparks and bloom around the arrow tip. thumbnails.concept_ko: 같은 시각 창원 라인은 풀가동 중이었다. 파트4의 '영업이익률 19.4% · 수출 86% · 세계 3위 · 차입 아닌 보유 현금으로 조달'이 근거. 사들인 쪽의 체급이 곧 메시지이므로 기계를 화면 밖까지 키우는 스케일 대비를 골랐다.

Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A colossal five-axis machining centre fills the whole width of the upper frame in exaggerated wide-angle perspective, its spindle biting into a steel workpiece and throwing a fountain of bright orange cutting sparks and glowing chips, coolant mist catching the light; a huge illuminated DN Solutions sign glows on the wall behind it and the DN Solutions logo is printed large on the machine's side panel, its light spilling amber across the steel and across stacked pallets of finished parts. On the right, a Korean factory engineer, an attractive person with a warm likeable face in a white work jacket with the DN Solutions logo on the chest, stands chest-up: narrowed confident eyes fixed on the cutting head, eyebrows level and low, lips pressed in a firm line with one corner slightly raised, chin lifted, one gloved hand resting flat and steady on the machine's control column. Two colours only — glowing amber-orange flooding the left and centre against a deep teal-blue industrial background — with strong rim light and bloom. No headline text, no caption text, no subtitle overlay, no numbers, no watermark; the only lettering anywhere is the DN Solutions brand logo described above, printed as a physical mark on the machine and the jacket.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목이 약속한 '유럽이 조용히 뒤집은 규칙'을 한 장면으로 이행한다. 파트5의 '2025.12.16 EU가 100%→90% 감축으로 완화, 하이브리드·PHEV·EREV·e-fuel 생존'이 근거. 시선을 규칙 그 자체에 몰아야 하므로 중앙 집중을 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain flat stone plaza paving — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A gigantic European Union flag in real heavy cloth fills the entire upper background, its deep blue field and ring of twelve gold stars glowing emissively and washing gold light over everything in front of it. Dead centre, lifted on a steel pedestal, sits a massive cast engine cylinder block; a thick red painted ban stroke slashed across its face is visibly half dissolved away, the erased half already flooded with fresh glowing green light that creeps back over the metal. On the right, Ursula von der Leyen (President of the European Commission) stands chest-up in a pale blazer under a bright studio key light: calm narrowed eyes deliberately turned away from the block, eyebrows relaxed, lips closed in a small tight controlled smile, one hand smoothing the front of her jacket, the other hand held low and open as if brushing something aside. Two colours rule — emissive EU blue and gold against the single surviving stroke of red — with lens bloom on the stars. No headline text, no caption text, no subtitle overlay, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 핵심인 '순서'를 그림으로 옮긴다. 창원의 서명이 먼저 있었고 그 뒤에 브뤼셀이 선을 고쳤다는 시간축을 좌→우 화살표로 못 박는다. 계약서 표지에 DN Solutions 로고를 얹어 '창원이 샀다'는 방향도 동시에 고정한다.

The left half of the upper frame is a signed share purchase contract folio lying open under glowing amber light, the DN Solutions logo and the HELLER logo printed side by side on its cover, a heavy fountain pen laid across the signature line and a red ink stamp pressed beside it; standing behind it chest-up is Kim Won-jong (DN Solutions CEO) in a dark suit, chin lifted, eyebrows low and level, narrowed steady eyes looking straight ahead past the camera, a faint closed-mouth triumphant grin, one hand laid flat and possessive on the contract. thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목이 약속한 '뒤집힘'을 같은 설비의 두 상태로 이행한다. 파트5~6의 '엔진 가공 설비의 수명이 늘었다 · 헬러 라인이 다시 돌기 시작한다'가 근거. 컨셉 A(같은 라인, 두 개의 겨울)의 실사 구현이다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain smooth grey shop floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. One single engine machining line photographed from a low wide angle and split down the middle by a hard vertical edge of light. Left half: the line is dead and drowned in cold steel-blue, dust sheets over the spindles, a blank paper notice pinned to the pillar, and a German master machinist half swallowed by shadow with his eyes half closed, both corners of his mouth pulled down, shoulders dropped, one hand hanging limp at his side. Only two colours across the frame — frozen steel-blue against burning amber — with strong bloom on the divide. No headline text, no caption text, no subtitle overlay, no numbers, no watermark; the only lettering anywhere is the DN Solutions brand logo described above, printed as a physical mark on the wall sign and the jacket.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 계승 불성립 판정에 따른 감정 클로즈업 1/3. 앵커 002의 패자 얼굴은 '국가 승패'를 증명하는 표정이지만, 이 장은 '서명하고 나서야 규칙이 풀렸다'는 순서를 알아버린 사람의 헛웃음이다. 파트5의 타이밍 아이러니가 근거.
